findings.summary: Client projection still duplicates the server reader slider percentage rule.
findings.consequence: If the slider percentage semantics change on the server, known facsimile page turns projected client-side can silently show a different slider position from the API-backed page state until both copies are updated together.
findings.evidence: The owned unit sets sliderPercent with the local sliderPercent helper at line 74. The same formula exists in server/api/reader/[author]/[title]/[page]/[mediatype].get.ts as readerSliderPercent and is used by commonReaderPage for API-backed Reader pages.
findings.recommendation: Extract the slider percentage calculation to a shared reader navigation/projection utility and use that from both commonReaderPage and projectFacsimileReaderPage, matching the existing extraction of resolveReaderPartNavigation.
